housing: Elmbridge is a commuter borough beside the Thames, south-west of London, with some of the highest house prices outside the capital. Homes range from large detached houses on private estates in Weybridge, Cobham and Esher to inter-war semis in Molesey and Hersham and modern flats near the town centres. Private lets include high-value family houses as well as flats. Homes near the Thames, Mole and Wey are in areas at risk of flooding.
checkinTips: Large detached houses: photograph every room from fixed points, plus gardens, gates, garages and any alarm panels, and note the number of keys, remotes and fobs.
Riverside homes near the Thames, Mole and Wey: photograph any damp tide marks, air bricks and flood barriers left for the tenant.
Homes with high-end fittings: photograph appliance makes and models, worktops and wooden floors closely, as damage to them is costly to dispute.
Modern flats near the town centres: photograph the entry system, bin store and parking space, and note fob and key counts.
Gardens, which are often large: photograph lawns, hedges, patios and sheds, and note any gardener included in the rent.
tenantHelp: Tenants with disrepair, damp or safety problems can contact Elmbridge Borough Council's environmental health team, which deals with private rented housing and can take action against landlords.
